notes.title: New update
Teleports
notes.content: Today I added system of teleports. Now You can press F and cell where you are staying will set as your home. Later You can teleport to home when You press G. The home cell has red color.

notes.title: Space base added
notes.content: Game was updated with new type of labyrinth - space base. It's harder than first one. You can try create this maze in mad mode too.
